concept.concept: Detailed botanical-style illustration of five common foraged mushrooms with their Latin names in a circular arrangement
concept.audience: Mushroom foragers, mycology enthusiasts, and science-art crossover buyers
concept.rationale: Mycology fandom is fast-growing with strong Etsy and niche platform traction. Fall foraging season starts in September. Botanical illustration style is on-trend and design-differentiated.

design.image_prompt: Flat vector illustration of five common edible mushrooms arranged in a circle: chanterelle, porcini, oyster, shiitake, and morel. Each mushroom shown in simple bold silhouettes with clean outlines and minimal internal detail lines. Solid color blocks only—no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Color palette: forest green, cream, burnt orange, deep brown, charcoal gray. Single centered composition on solid off-white background with generous margins. High contrast, screen-print aesthetic, readable at 12x16 inches.
design.style: flat vector illustration, bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, high contrast, screen-print aesthetic, solid color blocks only, no gradients, no photorealism

verdict.reason: Botanical-style illustrations of common foraged mushrooms with their Latin scientific names are in the public domain as a concept and style. Latin binomial nomenclature for species is generic scientific terminology not owned by any trademark holder. Circular arrangement is a common compositional choice. No brand names, characters, slogans, or protected intellectual property is referenced. This design presents negligible IP risk.

image_verdict.reason: Clean flat-style illustration of various mushroom types (chanterelles, morel, shiitake, etc.) arranged in a circular composition on a white background. No text, no IP concerns, no quality issues. Simple, original botanical motif suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Mycology Mug - Foraged Mushroom Botanical Illustration Cup
listing.description: For the amateur mycologist and fungi enthusiast. This mug features detailed botanical-style illustrations of five common foraged mushrooms arranged in a circular composition with their Latin names displayed. Educational and beautiful, celebrating the intersection of science and natural history. Ceramic, 11oz, dishwasher-safe. Perfect gift for mushroom foragers, mycology hobbyists, and anyone who appreciates nature-inspired science art.
